review.brief_reason: The simplification factors x2 out of sums in two places. In the first instance, (0.693147*x2 + 0.358577787894229*x2/x3) becomes x2*(0.693147 + 0.358577787894229/x3), which is algebraically exact. In the second instance, (1.149913*x2 + 0.693147*x2/sqrt(...))/x3 becomes x2*(1.149913 + 0.693147/sqrt(...))/x3, also exact. The third change factors x2 from (0.958786032514*x2 - 1.149913*x2/sqrt(...)) into x2*(0.958786032514 - 1.149913/sqrt(...)), which is exact. All variable mappings, constants, and operator semantics are preserved. The domain is identical since factoring does not introduce or remove any singularities beyond those already present.
